title: server_stores::new_mem and new_mem_no_search are near-duplicate 90-line functions
description: In store/server_stores.rs, new_mem and new_mem_no_search are ~90 lines each and differ only in whether TantivySearchIndex is constructed. The shared logic should be extracted into a single builder or an enum parameter so the duplication does not drift. Current state: any change to the shared init path must be made twice.
